title: CLAUDE.md becomes a pointer to AGENTS.md — the two inlined rules and their hook pointers leave
body:
Maintainer direct instruction to the skills seat (session `session_01MoTv7pn338AZ71owsp19gQ`, GitHub `os-justin`), given in that PM session's chat on 2026-09-09 at 13:3xZ and 13:4xZ, verbatim, untranslated:

> 「看一下 hotcrm 的agents.md 写的太乱了。只留下必要的。包括同时同时审核 hotcrm 的skills 任务，合并派发处理。」

> 「首先要明确 hotcrm 是元数据应用，平台功能应该在 objectstack中开发。 其次 claude.md 是不是直接让他阅读 agents.md 即可，没必要维护两套。所有仓库都有类似的问题」

Program anchor: #17161 (the shape, the four-axis note and the known cost are recorded there once). 

## This repo

`CLAUDE.md` (25 lines on `origin/main`) restates worktree-first and the stash ban with their hooks. After this card it says one thing: `AGENTS.md` is the source of truth, read it before anything else — nothing more. `.claude/hooks/` keep enforcing both rules; `AGENTS.md` 〈9. Operational Rules〉 already carries them (verify by grep before deleting). Gates that list `CLAUDE.md` (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `check-upstream-port-parity.mjs`, the doc-link and shell-residue scans) are re-run; any that requires prose in `CLAUDE.md` adapts in the same PR.

Governed (`CLAUDE.md`) ⇒ draft PR at the human terminal; objectui declares 「no changeset owed」 through its gate (⛔ no `skip-changeset` label here).
